name: builtin-themes
description: Default built-in themes for Vrutti IDE

injections.content:
#vrutti-live-wall-video { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; object-fit: cover; z-index: -1; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.5s ease; }
 body[style*="--vrutti-glass-bg"] #vrutti-live-wall-video, body[style*="rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)"] #vrutti-live-wall-video { opacity: 0.6; }

if (!document.getElementById('vrutti-live-wall-video')) { const v = document.createElement('video'); v.id = 'vrutti-live-wall-video'; v.src = 'https://cdn.pixabay.com/video/2018/01/29/13926-252726330_large.mp4'; v.autoplay = true; v.loop = true; v.muted = true; document.body.prepend(v); }
